latestInject.title: Desktop folder with two applications
latestInject.state: Inject 7 reviewed by evidence, timeline and response
latestInject.note: Response and timeline reviewed the File Explorer folder Tomodachi Life FREE. It lists setup.exe at 2 KB and another application at 82 KB, both dated 8/12/2026 10:39 AM. The middle of the first filename is visually ambiguous. No user, no run, and no zone are shown. The evidence log also has a reading.

assessment.label: Situation
assessment.text: At 08:43 on Dec 25, 2026 the distribution screen is DEGRADED: 12 of 18 feeders show no voltage or load, and Downtown and the Medical District show voltage with no load. Residents report no power or heat at 8:47 and 9:01 a.m. Cause not established. Reconciled through Inject 7 by Kevin's response chat at 13:10 PDT, pending leader review.

assessment.label: New findings
assessment.text: Password SSH logins from three public addresses; a contractor login at midnight; two su failures; adminelk sudo su to root; rsyslog stopped 44 s later. A Google new-sign-in alert. One managed Chrome profile downloaded Tomodachi Life FREE.zip and ryujinxx.exe and viewed 5freeedownloads.com. The desktop folder holds N0Tstea1nG?CredEntials.exe and setup.exe.

assessment.label: Leading hypotheses
assessment.text: Working hypothesis: a game-download lure, then credential theft, contractor login, root, logging stopped, grid affected. Each step is shown; the links are not (low to moderate confidence). Approved maintenance with an unrelated failure, a monitoring fault, or unrelated downloads remain open. A cyberattack is not established.

assessment.label: Contradictions
assessment.text: Footer 17/1 vs table 14/4 vs six feeders with voltage; FDR-04 and FDR-08 OFFLINE with load; 11:00 note vs 11:03:15 restart; 'Wed, Dec 24' vs Dec 24, 2026 being a Thursday; sudo[1802] below earlier process IDs. Resolved: PID 2189, script path, IP 104.237.236.191, domain 5freeedownloads.com.

assessment.label: Recommended action
assessment.text: Welfare checks and warming first; in-person checks of the Medical District and Downtown. Hold remote switching from whoville-scada. Image the host before changes. Call the four account owners, then disable the contractor's remote login. Isolate the I-005–I-007 computer without opening the files. Leader approves the presentation and public statement before 1:45 PM.

assessment.label: Critical unknowns
assessment.text: Breaker and relay history for 00:05:58–11:03:15; whose computer and Chrome profile; whether any file ran; authorization of the four accounts; who sent signal 15; year and zone of I-002 and I-003; presentation length, format and submission method.
